name: Legend
description: Represents the legend in a chart. Each chart can have only one legend.
remarks: The Legend object contains one or more LegendEntry objects; each LegendEntry object contains a LegendKey object. The chart legend is not visible unless the HasLegend property is True. If this property is False, properties and methods of the Legend object will fail.
example:
With ActiveDocument.InlineShapes(1)
 If .HasChart Then
 .Chart.Legend.Font.Bold = True
 End If
End With

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent for the specified object. Read-only Object.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns the name of the object. Read-only String.

properties.name: Position
properties.description: Returns or sets the position of the legend on the chart. Read/write XlLegendPosition.

properties.name: Shadow
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates whether the object has a shadow. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns or sets the height, in points, of the object. Read/write Double.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns the distance, in points, from the left edge of the object to the left edge of the chart area. Read-only Double.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance, in points, from the top edge of the object to the top of the first row (on a worksheet) or the top of the chart area (on a chart). Read/write Double.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns or sets the width, in points, of the object. Read/write Double.

properties.name: IncludeInLayout
properties.description: True if a legend will occupy the chart layout space when a chart layout is being determined. The default is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Format
properties.description: Returns the line, fill, and effect formatting for the object. Read-only ChartFormat.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application. When used with an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return the application of that object). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

methods.name: LegendEntries
methods.description: Returns a collection of legend entries for the legend.

methods.name: SetProperty
methods.signature: SetProperty(ID As String, Value As Variant)
